question: Use tao-prepare-od-coco to collapse scratch, dent, and stain COCO labels to one defect class while retaining diagnostic identity. Describe the plan only; do not run anything.
ground_truth: Use the TAO Data Services annotations project action with a nested YAML spec. It writes projected COCO, per-box metadata sidecar, detector classmap, and KPI alias mapping without reimplementing projection on the host.
expected_behavior: Selects the project action rather than model training or gap analysis
Uses annotations project with a YAML spec
Preserves original category and defect type per annotation and in a sidecar
Names projected_coco.json, annotation_metadata.jsonl, classmap.txt, and kpi_mapping.yaml
Does not run commands or mutate files

question: Use tao-prepare-od-coco to materialize a mined parquet of image paths as an RT-DETR COCO training source. Describe the plan only; do not run anything.
ground_truth: Use the TAO Data Services annotations stage action with source COCO, selected-path manifest, output directory, and a success-rate gate; consume the emitted images, annotations, classmap, and report.
expected_behavior: Uses annotations stage with a YAML spec
Requires a source COCO and selection manifest
Retains category order and custom annotation metadata
Treats duplicate basenames, zero resolved annotations, and insufficient success rate as errors
Does not run commands or mutate files
